verdict.rationale: Buzz is open source and self-hostable from the same codebase, with no external services required and a Helm chart that stores data in your own Postgres/S3. That means a team can run it at no license cost on infrastructure it controls. Agents can also search six months of history, which implies older messages remain accessible, though no source states an explicit retention policy. missing for 10: any documented free hosted tier or pricing, an explicit statement that message history is retained without limits or paywalls, and independent corroboration of long-term history access.
